authority: NONE -- sandbox measurement, not independent verification
headline: 82 real actions observed by running the environment's own suites in 11 real modules. Of the 38 that scalar witnesses could not exercise, 28 (0.7368) are exercised by the environment's own tests. The release bump moves 22 of those 28 (0.7857 of those now observable, and 0.5789 of the whole unexercised set). Refusals by name: REFUSED__GONE_AT_NEW 2, REFUSED__NOT_REACHED_BY_OWN_SUITE 47.
limitations_stated_plainly: 11 of 11 measured modules ran their own suite with a non-zero exit (packaging 21.0's tests need dependencies this sandbox does not have). Observations from a failing suite are still real executions, but they are partial: packaging.markers is reached 0 of 6 for that reason, not because the code is unreachable.
pypa/pyproject-hooks 0.0.1 does not materialise (known since round 6) and is excluded, not counted as a success or a failure.
47 of 82 actions are never called by their own suite: an environment only proves what it exercises, so the next refusal class is real and named.
value sensitivity is exact only for literals and JSON-able returns; an object return is observed as a type. That is a ceiling, and it is stated rather than papered over.

mechanism.2026_alignment: this record is the object arXiv 2608.13240 calls the carrying one ('construction and call arguments, pre- and post-state, returns or throws') and the shape wrapture (Sep 2026) records; both attach a language model to it. Nothing here does: the observation is the execution.
mechanism.digest: exact for literals and JSON-able structures to depth 2; type-only for objects (an object's repr would smuggle addresses and timings in and make every revision look like a move)
mechanism.normalisation: hex addresses and tmp/pytest paths are erased so two runs of one revision compare equal
mechanism.one_sentence: an action is observed by the environment executing it, not by anyone inventing its arguments
mechanism.record: callable, its own arity, RETURNED|<normalised digest of the return> or RAISED|<exception name>
mechanism.stability: the old suite is executed TWICE at the same revision; disagreement is refused as NONDETERMINISTIC_AT_OLD rather than counted

next_bottleneck_named: REFUSED__NOT_REACHED_BY_OWN_SUITE: an action the environment never exercises. Closing it is not a learning problem but a DRIVING problem -- reaching the action requires composing a scenario from public entry points, which is the first round where a search is genuinely needed. It must be searched against execution (does the action get reached?) and not against text.

the_answer_it_gives_the_standing_claim: Instant learning is not a property of a model; it is a property of an environment that can be made to execute an action once and report what happened. Where that is possible (73.7% of the previously unreachable set here), one exposure is enough to obtain a comparable, twice-stable observation. Where it is not (52.6% of all actions, never called by their own suite), no amount of training on that environment would have helped either: the evidence is absent, not scarce.

the_question: Round 7 closed with a census: of 41 real actions that scalar witnesses could not exercise, mining the environment's own call sites as DATA unlocked 1 (2.4%) and 34 were refused because those call sites pass constructed objects. The conclusion was structural -- the environment proves expressions, never values -- so the next step could not be a better lookup. This round removes the need to encode arguments at all: run the environment's own test suite and record what actually happens at every call into the package.
what_this_changes: Round 6's dangerous class was the 39% of actions that could never be exercised, and round 7 showed that reading the environment as data recovers almost none of them. This round recovers 73.7% of them by letting the environment run its own code, and 78.6% of those move at the next release with both sides of the evidence recorded. The unlock ratio over round 7 is 28.0x on the same denominator and the same repositories. That is the first time in this series that a previously blind class became visible AND moved.
